title: Annual Leave Policy
text: Full-time employees receive 20 paid annual leave days each calendar year.

title: Annual Leave Policy
text: Full-time employees receive 25 paid annual leave days each calendar year.

title: Expense Claim Policy
text: Employees must submit an expense claim within 30 calendar days of the purchase.

title: Expense Claim Policy
text: Employees must submit an expense claim within 14 calendar days of the purchase.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Eligible employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

title: Learning Budget Policy
text: The annual learning and development budget is AED 1000 per employee.

title: Learning Budget Policy
text: The annual learning and development budget is AED 1500 per employee.

title: Password Security Policy
text: Employees must change their password every 90 days.

title: Password Security Policy
text: Employees should use long unique passphrases and change a password immediately if compromise is suspected; routine 90-day rotation is not required.

title: Course Refund Policy
text: Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of payment.

title: Course Refund Policy
text: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of payment, subject to the listed eligibility conditions.
